sn55.26:1.2: The sick Anāthapiṇḍika was also consoled by Ānanda at SN 55.27:3.2. At MN 143, Sāriputta consoles him in his final hours. In other cases, we find the Buddha making such visits to sick monks (SN 22.87:2.7, SN 22.88:2.8, SN 46.14:2.1, SN 46.15:2.1, AN 6.56:2.1), but for some reason visits to householders are only attested for Sāriputta (MN 97:28.2) or Ānanda (SN 47.29:2.2).
sn55.26:18.3: Right knowledge and right freedom are normally only qualities of an arahant, but here they are ascribed to Anāthapiṇḍika though he is only a stream-enterer. See note on SN 45.26:2.2.
